meta.name: cavecrew
meta.description: When to delegate to `cavecrew-investigator` (locate code), `cavecrew-builder` (1-2 file edit) or `cavecrew-reviewer` (diff review) instead of working inline or using `Explore`. Their output is compressed, so main context lasts longer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需分派子代理处理代码定位、修改与审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常用 AI 写代码,想通过子代理分工节省上下文。
copy.tagline_en: Delegate to sub-agents for code search, edits, and reviews to save context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code with AI and want to manage context by delegating tasks to sub-agents.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在定位代码、1-2 文件小改或审查 diff 时会改派 cavecrew-investigator/builder/reviewer 子代理,拿回压缩的结构化结果,而不是自己直接搜改,省主上下文。
howto.when: 当任务是定位某段代码、在已知文件做 1-2 处小修,或审查 diff/分支找 bug,且希望输出精简时触发。

say.text: 用 cavecrew-reviewer 检查这个分支的 diff 有没有问题
say.note: 返回按文件和行号排序的问题及严重程度。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude delegates code-location, small 1-2 file edits, or diff review to cavecrew-investigator/builder/reviewer subagents and returns their compressed structured results instead of exploring or editing inline, saving main context.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task is locating code, small edits to 1-2 known files, or reviewing a diff/branch for bugs, and you want terse output.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-investigator to find where getUsers is defined
say_en.note: Returns a compressed list with path:line and symbols.

say_en.text: Have cavecrew-builder edit lines 3 and 8 in src/util.ts
say_en.note: Out-of-scope edits return too-big or ambiguous.

say_en.text: Use cavecrew-reviewer to check this branch's diff for bugs
say_en.note: Returns findings sorted by file and line with severity.
